## Direct Answer: When Will the RRB NTPC & Technician Admit Cards Be Released?

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> **Core Fact**: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) activates the official **City Intimation Slip exactly 10 days before** the scheduled Computer Based Test (CBT) date, allowing candidates to view their exam city, state, shift timing, and download free SC/ST railway travel passes. The final **e-Call Letter (Admit Card) is made available for download exactly 4 days prior** to the candidate's specific exam date on the centralized portal `rrbapply.gov.in` and respective regional RRB websites. Mandatory Aadhaar-linked biometric verification will be conducted at all exam centers.

Over 1.2 crore applicants across India are eagerly awaiting official examination dates and hall tickets for **RRB Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC)**—spanning Graduate posts (Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk) and Undergraduate posts (Junior Clerk cum Typist, Trains Clerk)—as well as **RRB Technician Grade 1 Signal and Grade 3**. This live tracker breaks down the verified exam schedule, shift timings, direct regional login links, and the step-by-step procedure to download your admit card without errors.

---

## Difference Between Exam City Slip and Official e-Call Letter

Many candidates mistake the City Intimation Slip for their final admit card. It is critical to recognize the distinction to prevent entry denial on exam day:

### 1. Exam City Intimation Slip (Released 10 Days Before Exam)
- **Purpose**: Informs you of the designated Exam City, State, Shift Date, and Shift Timing so outstation candidates can arrange travel and accommodation.
- **Travel Pass**: Eligible SC/ST candidates receive an integrated Sleeper Class Railway Travel Authority Pass with this slip.
- **Entry Validity**: **The City Slip is NOT valid for exam hall entry.** You cannot enter the test venue with this document.

### 2. Official e-Call Letter / Admit Card (Released 4 Days Before Exam)
- **Purpose**: Contains your assigned Exam Center Name, Full Venue Address, Landmark, Roll Number, Reporting Time, Gate Closing Time, and Candidate Barcode.
- **Entry Validity**: **Mandatory for exam hall entry.** Must be printed on clean A4 paper along with an original valid Photo Identity Card.

---

## Official RRB CBT Shift Timings & Gate Closing Protocol

Railway exams are conducted in 3 distinct shifts daily across hundreds of TCS iON computerized testing centers. Adherence to reporting times is strictly monitored:

| Shift | Candidate Reporting Time | Gate Closing Time (Strict) | Exam Commencement | Exam Duration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Shift 1 (Morning)** | 07:30 AM | **08:30 AM** | 09:00 AM | 09:00 AM – 10:30 AM (90 Mins) |
| **Shift 2 (Afternoon)** | 11:30 AM | **12:30 PM** | 01:00 PM | 01:00 PM – 02:30 PM (90 Mins) |
| **Shift 3 (Evening)** | 03:30 PM | **04:30 PM** | 05:00 PM | 05:00 PM – 06:30 PM (90 Mins) |

> [!WARNING]  
> **Absolute Gate Closure Rule**: The exam center main entrance is locked precisely at the Gate Closing Time. Candidates arriving even 1 minute late will be turned away without exception. No appeals or special requests are entertained by test center administrators.

## Step-by-Step Guide: How to Download Your RRB Admit Card 2026

Follow these sequential steps to retrieve and print your official hall ticket:

1. **Open the Centralized Railway Portal**: Visit the unified Railway recruitment platform at [rrbapply.gov.in](https://rrbapply.gov.in) or navigate to your regional RRB board website.
2. **Click on the Recruitment Notice Link**: Locate the active headline titled *'CEN 05/2024 (NTPC) or CEN 02/2024 (Technician) - Download e-Call Letter & City Slip'*.
3. **Enter Candidate Authentication Credentials**:
   - **Registration Number**: Your 10-digit application registration ID issued during initial form submission.
   - **User Password / Date of Birth**: Enter your birth date in standard `DD/MM/YYYY` format.
   - **Security Captcha**: Enter the visible letters and numerals displayed on the screen.
4. **Access Candidate Dashboard**: Upon login, click on the **'e-Call Letter'** tab on the left navigation drawer.
5. **Review Details Carefully**: Verify that your Name, Father's Name, Category, Photograph, and Signature are clearly visible without distortion.
6. **Print and Save PDF**: Download the PDF file and print at least two crisp copies on standard white A4 paper using a laser printer.

---

## Mandatory Checklist: Documents Required at the Exam Hall

Candidates must carry all the following items to clear the multi-layer security and biometric checkpoint:

1. **Printed e-Call Letter**: Clean, legible hard copy with candidate details and barcode intact.
2. **Original Valid Photo ID Card (Mandatory)**: Must carry the exact original ID presented during online registration:
   - Aadhaar Card / E-Aadhaar with clear photograph
   - Voter ID Card
   - PAN Card
   - Passport
   - Driving License
   *(Note: Photocopies, digital copies on DigiLocker, or scanned phone images are NOT accepted for physical entry.)*
3. **Two Recent Passport-Size Photographs**: Exactly matching the photo uploaded in the application form (size 35mm x 45mm).
4. **SC/ST Travel Authority Pass (If Applicable)**: Original printed copy along with community certificate if availing free train journey.
5. **Transparent Blue / Black Ballpoint Pen**: For signing the rough sheet and attendance sheet.

### Strictly Prohibited Items Inside the Examination Hall
- Mobile phones, smartwatches, digital wristwatches, fitness bands, and Bluetooth earphones.
- Calculators, pen drives, memory cards, electronic pagers, or recording devices.
- Wallets, leather belts with large metallic buckles, pouches, goggles, and handbags.
- Geometry boxes, scale, writing pads, books, notes, or loose pieces of paper.

## Important CBT-1 Examination Pattern & Normalized Scoring Rules

While downloading your admit card, keep the examination structure fresh in mind to execute your strategy with confidence:

| Section | Number of Questions | Total Marks | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| **General Awareness** | 40 Questions | 40 Marks | Composite 90 Minutes (120 Mins for PwBD) |
| **Mathematics** | 30 Questions | 30 Marks | |
| **General Intelligence & Reasoning** | 30 Questions | 30 Marks | |
| **Total Composite** | **100 Questions** | **100 Marks** | **90 Minutes** |

- **Negative Marking**: Exactly **1/3rd (0.33) marks deducted** for every wrong attempt.
- **Score Normalization**: Multi-session exam scores are adjusted using the official RRB Percentile-Based Normalization Formula.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### Q1: What should I do if I forgot my RRB NTPC Registration Number?
Visit `rrbapply.gov.in` and click on *'Forgot Registration ID'*. Enter your registered mobile number, email address, and date of birth. You will receive an OTP and your registration number will be sent via SMS and email.

### Q2: Can I change my allotted examination city or center?
No. The Railway Recruitment Board does not entertain any requests for center or city modification under any circumstances. Examination centers are allocated automatically via computer algorithm to prevent irregularities.

### Q3: Is the Aadhaar card mandatory for the RRB exam?
Yes. The Ministry of Railways has implemented mandatory Aadhaar-enabled biometric authentication at entry. Candidates who registered using another photo ID must carry their original Aadhaar card as well to avoid delays at the verification counter.

### Q4: How can SC/ST candidates avail free train travel for RRB exams?
Eligible SC/ST candidates who opted for free travel authority during application can download their Free Sleeper Class Travel Pass alongside the City Intimation Slip. Take this printout along with original caste certificate and e-Call Letter to any railway ticket reservation counter to book a free sleeper berth.

### Q5: What if my photograph or signature on the admit card is blurred?
Immediately contact your respective regional RRB helpline with your application receipt. Additionally, carry two original passport-size photographs matching your application and valid government photo IDs to the test center controller desk on the morning of your exam.
